note: Reference frames for the local control protocol v1. The Go tests check every entry, and the Lua bridge (M13) is expected to reuse the same file so both sides agree on the bytes rather than on a description of them. Each `line` is the frame without its trailing newline.

valid_requests.name: non-ASCII values are carried as UTF-8, not escaped by the sender
a newline inside a value must arrive escaped, so the frame stays one line

invalid_requests.name: an extra envelope field, which is how a privilege parameter would be smuggled in
an array instead of an object
a request id longer than 128 characters, which every response and log line would carry

undeclared_methods.name: a method that does not exist
a shell-looking name is just an unknown name; nothing here executes strings
the CLI command name, which is not an RPC method

responses.name: the success example from the contract
a permanent failure
responses.line: {"rpc_version":1,"request_id":"save-42","ok":false,"result":null,"error":{"code":"Conflict","message":"配置已被其他地方修改，请重新加载后再保存","details":{"expected_revision":"7","actual_revision":"8"},"retryable":false}}

responses.name: a transient failure
responses.line: {"rpc_version":1,"request_id":"login-1","ok":false,"result":null,"error":{"code":"BindingUnavailable","message":"所选线路当前没有可用的 IPv4 地址","details":{"interface":"wan.v2"},"retryable":true}}

responses.name: a parse failure, answered with an empty request id because none was readable
responses.line: {"rpc_version":1,"request_id":"","ok":false,"result":null,"error":{"code":"InvalidArgument","message":"请求不是有效的 JSON 对象","retryable":false}}

responses.name: a read that ran out of its three seconds; the same request unchanged may well succeed
a busy daemon telling the caller how long to wait
responses.line: {"rpc_version":1,"request_id":"login-2","ok":false,"result":null,"error":{"code":"Busy","message":"已有动作正在执行，请稍后再试","details":{"retry_after_seconds":"5"},"retryable":true}}

responses.name: a fault inside the daemon: a stable code and nothing about the cause
